prompt:
The bar chart below shows the number of international visitors to one region in five selected years, and the pie chart shows the reasons they gave for their visit in 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visuals.title: International visitors to the region, 2010-2022
visuals.alt: A bar chart showing the number of international visitors to the region for five years between 2010 and 2022.

visuals.title: Reasons given for visiting the region, 2022
visuals.alt: A pie chart showing the percentage breakdown of the reasons given by people who visited the region in 2022.

key_points: Visitor numbers more than double over the period, rising from 320,000 to 690,000
The rise is not steady: numbers dip to 380,000 in 2016, the only fall in the period, before climbing again
The fastest growth is between 2016 and 2019 (an increase of 180,000); the rise between 2019 and 2022 is also large (130,000)
In 2022, almost half of visitors come for a holiday (46%) — by far the most common reason
Visiting friends or relatives is second at 24%, business third at 18%; study (8%) and other reasons (4%) together make up only about an eighth of the total
Reading the two charts together shows that of the 690,000 people in 2022, roughly 317,000 were holidaymakers
common_mistakes: Describing only one of the two visuals — the task covers both.
Confusing thousands of people with percentages ('46,000 visitors came on holiday')
Forgetting that the pie chart covers only 2022 and extending it to every year ('most visitors always came on holiday')
Skipping the 2016 dip and presenting the increase as unbroken
Inventing reasons or making predictions about the future
